Date Custom Fields — Edit

Create a custom field for date values.

Date fields are useful for tracking expiry dates, renewal dates, or other important dates.

Name

Enter the name of this date custom field. This label appears on forms and reports.

Date fields are ideal for tracking deadlines, expiry dates, milestone dates, or any time-based information.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Consider grouping related date fields together using sequential position numbers.

Placement

Select where this date field should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

Common uses: contract dates on customers, expiry dates on inventory, milestone dates on projects.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the field. This guides users on what date to enter.

Be specific about which date is needed, like 'Enter contract expiry date' or 'Date of last inspection'.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being copied when duplicating records.

Enable for dates that should be re-entered fresh, like inspection dates or review dates.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the date field value on the View screen after saving.

Display important dates like expiry dates, due dates, or renewal dates for quick reference.

Show at the top of printed documents

If displayed on View, check this box to show the field at the top of the View screen.

Place time-sensitive dates at the top, such as expiry dates or critical deadlines.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this date field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

Past date entries remain in the system and the field can be reactivated if requirements change.
